text: No, I have never worked with asbestos or been around birds or mold. Yes, I get very winded even after climbing just one flight of stairs. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) with secondary pulmonary congestion.

Given your confirmed history of HCM and the severe dyspnea on minimal exertion, the interstitial markings likely represent pulmonary edema due to left ventricular outflow obstruction rather than primary lung fibrosis. Do you notice any palpitations or a sensation of your heart "skipping beats" when these symptoms occur?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with possible pulmonary fibrosis
